mostWorthwhile.text: Building the lymph route from tissue spaces to a vein was most worthwhile: the planned closeups trace fluid and proteins through each structure, then show why the route matters to the whole model.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed attempt to add tissue spaces directly to the supplied framework was frustrating: the result gave no compatibility information or explanation of why the route had to be built separately.

surprise.text: The supplied framework could not combine with anything at that point, despite already showing tissue capillaries; the lymph route had to be assembled separately first.

arbitrary.text: The need to construct the lymph network separately before attaching it felt somewhat arbitrary, although the individual connections had clear purposes.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: connecting previously built systems and tracing the consequences of fluid return made the constructions more meaningful. This is a judgment of the supplied text and illustration plans, not evidence of student comprehension.
